8:62.text: And if they intend to deceive you, then verily, Allâh is All-Sufficient for you. He it is Who has supported you with His Help and with the believers.

8:63.text: hearts. If you had spent all that is in the earth, you could not have united their hearts, but Allâh has united them. Certainly He is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

8:64.text: ! Allâh is Sufficient for you and for the believers who follow you.

8:65.text: ! Urge the believers to fight. If there are twenty steadfast persons amongst you, they will overcome two hundreds, and if there be a hundred steadfast persons they will overcome a thousand of those who disbelieve, because they
are people who do not understand.

8:66.text: , for He knows that there is weakness in you. So if there are of you a hundred steadfast persons, they shall overcome two hundreds, and if there are a thousand of you, they shall overcome two thousand with the Leave of Allâh. And Allâh is with As-Sâbirûn

8:67.text: It is not for a Prophet that he should have prisoners of war
until he had made a great slaughter
in the land. You desire the good of this world
(i.e. the money of ransom for freeing the captives)
the Hereafter. And Allâh is All-Mighty, All-Wise.

8:68.text: Were it not a previous ordainment from Allâh, a severe torment would have touched you for what you took.

8:69.text: So enjoy what you have gotten of booty in war, lawful and good, and be afraid of Allâh. Certainly, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
